content.comment_body: Hello, I have a project where timers and analog inputs are used. I need to set analog setpoints and timer values through the LCD using the built-in keys, similar to an HMI screen. How can I achieve this?

You should configure the parameters you wish to change within a message text (refer to [document]). When you want to adjust a parameter, select the relevant message text. Once selected, hold the ESC key for more than 2 seconds. This will display a black bar in the input/output field. Use the up or down cursor keys to navigate between fields. To modify a field, select it and press the OK button (on the display unit, > Enter). The black bar becomes a flashing box—now you can use the cursor keys to alter the value or switch position. When finished, press OK again to return to the black bar. You can then select another field, or exit the process by pressing ESC.
Thank you for your response. I will try this solution and hope it resolves my issue.

analysis.insight_summary: The core user issue is about adjusting setpoints for analog inputs and timers directly through the device's LCD and built-in keys, similar to an HMI experience. Guidance offered a step-by-step process for navigating message text fields and utilizing key combinations to select and modify parameter values. Although the interface might seem complicated for beginners, following the described procedure fulfills the user's requirements, as confirmed by resolution feedback.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to easily adjust setpoints and timer values through the LCD interface using available device keys, emulating HMI-like functionality.
